title: Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD
description:
Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD

Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD role at Trilogy.

This range is provided by Trilogy. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$200.00/hr - $200.00/hr

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years in product leadership positions where you personally developed product vision and owned fundamental problem-solution hypotheses
  • Proven track record launching at least one successful product from conception to market—specifically a complete product (not just features) that reached external users and generated minimum $1M in revenue
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI tools into your professional workflow (analysis, research, strategy development, information synthesis)

About LearnWith.AI

LearnWith.AI is an edtech startup that leverages AI and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and AI-powered coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult for more details on this topic.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

Com foco em soluções ágeis e escaláveis, desenvolvem projetos que impactam milhões de clientes. Em um ambiente colaborativo, buscam constantemente a excelência em tecnologia e inovação.

Procuramos um Gerente de Sistemas para integrar nosso time de Cloud atuando no time B-IPRO.

Responsibilities

  • Será responsável por desenvolver produtos relacionados a infraestrutura de redes, garantindo alta performance e escalabilidade. É essencial entender o funcionamento de redes e como se conectam em ambientes Cloud;
  • Atuação estratégica e técnica;
  • Selecionar, formar e avaliar lideranças diretas (coordenadores / squad-leads) e seus subordinados;
  • Planejar a evolução do produto de acordo com a estratégia da organização, tendências de mercado, demanda dos clientes e capacidade do time.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação na área de tecnologia;
  • Experiência sólida com infraestrutura e desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência sólida em redes;
  • Profundo conhecimento em arquitetura de cloud.

Benefícios

  • VR/VA, Vale Transporte, Assistência Médica e Odontológica e Auxílio Creche.
  • Gympass para bem-estar e saúde.
  • Bolsa de estudo com até 50% de desconto.
  • Descontos especiais nas empresas do Grupo Magalu (Magalu, Netshoes, Época Cosméticos, Estante Virtual, Kabum entre outras).
  • Auxílio Creche

Modelo de Trabalho

Adotamos o modelo 100% remoto, proporcionando flexibilidade, enquanto mantém a interação virtual com a equipe para garantir uma colaboração eficaz e um ambiente de crescimento contínuo.

Se você busca um ambiente de crescimento e desafios, vem ser feliz!

Nossos valores nos unem e nossas diferenças nos potencializam como um grupo. Mais do que igualdade, buscamos equidade: aqui, temos espaço para sermos autênticos, independentemente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, clero ou deficiência.

SOBRE A BUZZCREATORS
A Buzzcreators é uma plataforma brasileira especializada em conectar marcas com influenciadores, especialmente micro e nano influenciadores, para a criação e gestão de campanhas de marketing de influência. Ela oferece uma solução automatizada e baseada em dados para facilitar todo o processo, desde o planejamento até a execução e pagamento das campanhas.

Vaga - 100% HOME OFFICE

O SDR em vendas (Sales Development Representative, ou Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas) terá a responsabilidade de identificar e qualificar leads, estabelecer contatos, criar oportunidades de negócio e auxiliar os times comerciais.   • Ensino superior em andamento ou completo;

  • Experiência com Atendimento (SAC 4.0);

title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Overview

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

As a Product Manager on the Lending Application Intake team, you’ll support the core member application experience that powers our lending platform. You’ll work closely to deliver small features that improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of loan applications — from initial intake through decisioning.

This is a hands-on learning role where you’ll develop the fundamentals of product management within a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll learn how digital lending works, how credit unions serve their members, and how to turn complex workflows into simple, delightful product experiences, driving impact to our credit union customers and their members.

About the Team

You’ll join a high-talent density Product & Engineering org with a culture of ownership, speed, and judgment. PMs here work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and GTM peers, driving clarity and tough tradeoffs instead of waiting for direction.

This is a pivotal time at Clutch: we are on a strong growth path, and how we scale account opening in the next 12 months will define how Clutch builds durable company leverage.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turning urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence : Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills : You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility : Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites : Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays : Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options : Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup : Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget : Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note : This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch : We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

title: Finance Development Program
description:
Join Our Finance Development Program - FP&A entry level role and embark on a journey to enrich your financial expertise through hands-on training and on-the-job experiences. As part of our Global Finance Services team, you'll be at the forefront of our quest for world-class finance, contributing to our expanding operations from our Costa Rica hub. This program is designed to equip candidates starting their careers with a financial skillset, enhancing their resumes and paving the way for future success. You will report to a local Costa Rica team Manager.

Main Responsibilities

  • Support fundamental month-end close processes and journal entries using Oracle and OBIEE.
  • Prepare monthly reconciliations and fulfill ad hoc requests for revenue/cost reporting and analysis.
  • Promote basic standardization efforts and efficiency enhancements across financial reporting and analysis models, applying multiple methods such as RPA, Lean Six Sigma, Tableau.
  • Support entry-level monthly tasks for the corresponding department.
  • Follow service level agreements (SLAs) and performance metrics.
  • Develop desktop procedure documents for routine processes.

About Experian

Experian is a global company in data services, helping organizations and consumers manage risk and make informed decisions. We empower individuals and businesses at important life moments, from purchasing a home to expanding customer bases. With over 125 years of experience, we specialize in data gathering, analysis, and fraud prevention. Our 21,700 employees across 30 countries are dedicated to innovation and creating opportunities for a better tomorrow. Responsabilidades

  • Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Dados & Governança com sólida experiência em arquitetura de soluções, liderança técnica e governança corporativa em ambientes de dados modernos.
  • O(a) profissional terá como missão definir e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis em plataformas Lakehouse, promover boas práticas de governança e DataOps e atuar como líder estratégico para times técnicos e de negócio, conectando dados a valor corporativo em escala global.

Arquitetura De Soluções

  • Projetar arquiteturas Lakehouse modernas, utilizando plataformas como Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Lakehouse Federation).
  • Definir padrões de ingestão e transformação (batch, streaming, eventos) com Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, Liquid Clustering.
  • Modelar dados em arquiteturas Medallion (Raw, Silver, Gold), incluindo camadas de consumo (serving, APIs, BI, ML).
  • Estruturar integrações com sistemas legados, SaaS, SAP, DMS, ERPs e aplicações corporativas.
  • Apoiar projetos de Data Mesh e domínios de dados, com foco em escalabilidade e ownership.
  • Conectar dados a Analytics, Data Science e GenAI, viabilizando casos de uso avançados (predição, recomendação, copilots).
  • Avaliar e recomendar padrões arquiteturais (streaming-first, event-driven, real-time analytics).
  • Conduzir design reviews e provas de conceito para novas soluções de dados.
  • Apoiar estratégias de custo otimizado (compute, storage, caching, auto-scaling).
  • Documentar e disseminar blueprints corporativos de arquitetura de dados.

Governança e Estratégia

  • Definir e operacionalizar frameworks de Data Governance corporativa (catálogo, glossário, lineage, ownership, stewardship, qualidade).
  • Implantar políticas de segurança, privacidade e compliance (LGPD, GDPR, HIPAA), incluindo anonimização e criptografia.
  • Estabelecer políticas de classificação de dados (sensibilidade, retenção, criticidade) aplicadas em catálogos e camadas de dados.
  • Conduzir avaliações de maturidade em governança de dados e elaborar roadmaps de evolução. Apoiar o desenho e execução de modelos operacionais de governança (Hub & Spoke, centralizado, federado).
  • Introduzir automações de governança com Unity Catalog, AI/GenAI para classificação, lineage automático e sugestão de glossário.
  • Conduzir processos de definição de ownership e stewardship com áreas de negócio.
  • Estabelecer métricas e KPIs de governança (cobertura de catálogo, nível de qualidade, adoção de glossário, acessos).
  • Apoiar iniciativas de AI Governance, incluindo catalogação e ciclo de vida de modelos.
  • Atuar como ponte entre times de negócio, segurança e engenharia, garantindo adoção e alinhamento corporativo.

Liderança Técnica

  • Atuar como referência técnica e arquitetural, orientando engenheiros, analistas e cientistas.
  • Conduzir revisões de arquitetura e propor blueprints de dados corporativos.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre times técnicos e executivos.

DataOps e Automação

  • Implementar CI/CD de dados com GitLab/GitHub, Terraform e Databricks Asset Bundles.
  • Garantir qualidade de dados com testes automatizados (DQX, Pytest, SQLFluff).
  • Apoiar práticas de MLOps com MLflow, Feature Store e monitoramento de modelos.
  • Explorar uso de GenAI e automação inteligente em governança e qualidade.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de dados moderna (Lakehouse, Medallion).
  • Sólida atuação em Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Federation).
  • Domínio em Python para pipelines e automações.
  • Vivência prática em ambientes multi-cloud (AWS, Azure).
  • Conhecimento em Data Governance, segurança e compliance.

Soft Skills

  • Visão arquitetural estratégica, com foco em impacto e valor de negócio.
  • Perfil líder, colaborativo e influenciador, com capacidade de orientar e engajar times.
  • Comunicação executiva clara, traduzindo complexidade técnica em decisões de negócio.

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products and services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity: We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

Responsibilities

  • Be the customer-facing, first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via tools like Slack and Jira.
  • Provide Mac-focused enterprise troubleshooting; manage provisioning and maintenance of macOS in the enterprise.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding experience for new employees and the offboarding/client decommissioning process.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge base.
  • Manage SaaS applications including Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and improve IDP and SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate repetitive tasks.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents to completion; balance help desk tickets with project work.
  • Participate in projects over sprints; document work in Jira and apply agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn (Qualifications)

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to convey complex ideas clearly and with empathy.
  • Strong security mindset and basic understanding of PGP.
  • Networking fundamentals and troubleshooting across OSI layers; TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching.
  • Self-management with strong organizational and priority-setting skills; comfortable navigating ambiguity.
  • Ability to work autonomously and across multiple teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (not required to be certified).
  • Experience with GAM and command-line tools for efficient operations.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Leadership mindset suitable for startup/tech environments; adaptable, resilient, and comfortable with ambiguity in a high-growth setting.
  • Builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative, empathetic cross-functional partner with integrity and accountability for confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities as a leading digital asset company.
  • Competitive total rewards package starting from day one, including PTO.
  • Employee ownership through equity and remote work flexibility up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Purpose-driven work and removal of barriers to doing what you love.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process, please email the Ledn team. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our team is global and remote-first, spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

Please note: due to the high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response, and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Transformando mercados com tecnologia há mais de 30 anos. Nós impactamos vidas através da Tecnologia.

Fomos pioneiros na digitalização da Justiça brasileira e seguimos expandindo os limites do que é possível com Inteligência Artificial.

Estamos desenvolvendo um produto de alto impacto para a Justiça , que combina IA generativa, segurança de dados e arquitetura escalável para apoiar magistrados e tribunais em decisões mais céleres, consistentes e explicáveis.

É um desafio inédito: aplicar IA de ponta em escala nacional, com rigor técnico, responsabilidade e impacto direto na vida de milhões de cidadãos.

Além da engenharia, buscamos alguém com perfil de evangelização técnica — capaz de documentar entregas e descobertas, apresentar resultados em fóruns internos e externos, compartilhar boas práticas e contribuir para disseminar uma cultura de IA ética, segura e orientada a impacto.

Você fará parte da equipe que está construindo uma das arquiteturas de IA mais avançadas já aplicadas ao sistema de Justiça .

O projeto combina múltiplas camadas tecnológicas, vetorização semântica, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), multi-LLMs e pipelines distribuídos, para compreender grandes volumes de dados jurídicos de forma segura e explicável.

O impacto vai além da tecnologia: cada decisão apoiada pela nossa IA pode representar mais eficiência, menos morosidade e mais acesso à Justiça para a sociedade.

É uma jornada que une ciência de dados, engenharia de alta performance e ética no uso da IA, buscando profissionais que queiram atuar na fronteira entre inovação tecnológica e transformação pública.

Como Cientista de Dados com foco em IA Generativa, você será responsável por:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de IA do produto, garantindo escalabilidade, rastreabilidade e explicabilidade.
  • Liderar iniciativas com LLMs, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para geração de soluções seguras e contextualizadas.
  • Aplicar fundamentos de estatística, probabilidade e algoritmos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clusterização etc.) em análises e avaliações de performance.
  • Orquestrar integrações entre sistemas judiciais, serviços em nuvem e provedores de IA .
  • Projetar, implementar e monitorar pipelines envolvendo vector DBs e frameworks de GenAI ( LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, entre outros) .
  • Criar e refinar engenharia de prompts em cenários complexos e diversos.
  • Traduzir resultados técnicos em insights claros e acionáveis , comunicando descobertas e limitações a públicos diversos (técnicos e executivos).
  • Documentar experimentos, resultados e boas práticas, promovendo transparência e reprodutibilidade .
  • Evangelizar o uso responsável e eficiente da IA, representando a empresa em talks, artigos e comunidades técnicas .
  • Garantir compliance e anonimização de dados sensíveis , em linha com LGPD e regulamentações do setor público.
  • Contribuir com o desenho e evolução da arquitetura distribuída (multi-workers/processors) conectada a sistemas judiciais e múltiplos LLMs.
  • Conhecimento em estatística, probabilidade e algoritmos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clusterização etc.).
  • Experiência prática com Grandes Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) e técnicas de prompting, embeddings e RAG.
  • Familiaridade com o ecossistema de GenAI, incluindo frameworks e bibliotecas que aceleram o desenvolvimento com LLMs e vector databases.
  • Vivência em vector DBs (pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone, Milvus ou equivalentes).
  • Sólida base em Python e Node/TypeScript para automações e integrações.
  • Experiência em arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em segurança e privacidade de dados (LGPD, PII), em especial questões de anonimização.
  • Capacidade de comunicar e apresentar insights complexos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Experiência anterior como arquiteto de soluções ou líder técnico em projetos complexos de IA.

Background

title: Staff Product Manager | Explore&Search
description:
Overview

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager in our Explore&Search Team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Consumer Experience team in Product & Technology is responsible for evolving our product towards providing a simple, engaging and delightful partner discoverability experience, helping users start and cultivate their wellbeing journey with Wellhub.

The Explore & Search team's goal is to evolve the Wellhub app's browsing and search journeys providing users with an increasingly intuitive experience for discovering our diverse range of partners and activities, showcasing Wellhub' value proposition in order to attract, engage, and retain subscribers.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the product vision for providing a great partner discoverability experience for our Members and Subscribers.
  • Defined product requirements, actively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within Wellhub to propose new product solutions as well as to continuously review and improve the current product functionality and performance;
  • Analyze and assess product opportunities to unlock better partner discoverability and value perception of Wellhub's network
  • Build, communicate and discuss your product vision with internal stakeholders;
  • Drive product planning, build and manage high quality roadmaps;
  • Work closely with data, product design, engineering, and data science teams to deliver well rounded, scalable and stunning product features;
  • Define goals, metrics, track, and report their progress;
  • Design and run user tests, qualitative surveys, and AB tests.
  • Analyze product data to generate insights and identify opportunities that range from the end user experience all the way to the Search & Recommendation APIs, from improving the way partners are showcased on the interface to rankings and models.
  • Work closely with the Technical Program Manager responsible for the APIs to ensure planning alignment and smooth product improvements cycles.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products, in close collaboration with engineering and design team members;
  • Hands on mindset, entrepreneurial and self-driven spirit with a great desire to make things happen;
  • Analytical and quantitative skills is a must, ability to use data and metrics to generate insights, iterate and improve the product;
  • Strong problem solving - be able to structure problems, prioritize and make pragmatic decisions in unstructured environments;
  • Capacity to identify and connect users needs and business needs, and develop effective ideas to meet them
  • Ability to analyze complex requirements and intricate user flows in order to translate them into simple, friendly and intuitive solutions – with attention to detail.
  • Ability to discuss high-level product decisions as well as technical details effectively when necessary
  • Experience with consumer facing digital products. Marketplace experience is a plus.
  • Experience in managing user facing products that integrate with machine learning APIs, search and recommender systems is a plus.
  • Previous experience in search and browsing product journeys is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products is a mandatory requirement.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Privacy notice for Candidates (Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos).

description:
Seu futuro merece essa energia!

Nós acreditamos que a energia que você dedica à sua carreira merece retorno.

Por isso, reconhecemos a dedicação das nossas pessoas e estamos sempre em busca de quem deseja fazer a diferença e construir uma trajetória próspera e segura.

Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito.

Analista de Tributos Federais Sênior

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

  • Formação Superior Completa: Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou Economia.
  • Experiência com cálculo e apuração de tributos federais: PIS, COFINS, IRPJ e CSLL, revisão de obrigações acessórias (ECF, EFD Contribuições, Per/Dcomp, DCTF, MIT) e conciliações contábeis.
  • Conhecimento dos regimes tributários: lucro real e presumido.
  • Vivência com fiscalização com órgãos fiscalizadores (Receita Federal).
  • Vivência com atendimento a auditorias.
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP, preferencialmente sistema SAP.
  • Experiência com solução fiscal, preferencialmente TaxOne.
  • Pacote Office avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Campinas/SP.
  • Desejável Inglês.
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI) e ferramentas de automação de processos.
  • Experiência no setor elétrico será considerada um diferencial.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Revisar a apuração dos tributos federais (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS e outros), assegurando a correta interpretação da legislação, integridade dos dados fiscais e cumprimento dos prazos legais.
  • Contribuir para a implementação e o monitoramento das regras do Pilar 2, assegurando a conformidade da empresa com a tributação mínima global.
  • Coordenar e revisar a elaboração das obrigações acessórias federais (EFD-Contribuições, ECF, DIRB, DCTF Web e PerDcomp Web), garantindo a consistência, integridade e qualidade das informações entregues ao Fisco.
  • Liderar estudos para identificação de oportunidades de otimização da carga tributária, incluindo aproveitamento de créditos, benefícios fiscais e regimes especiais.
  • Atuar como ponto focal no atendimento a auditorias internas e externas, fiscalizações da Receita Federal e demais órgãos reguladores, conduzindo defesas fiscais, elaboração de documentos e prestação de esclarecimentos técnicos.
  • Assessorar tecnicamente áreas internas (Contabilidade, Jurídico, Planejamento Tributário, Regulatório, Faturamento) quanto a operações com implicações tributárias relevantes, garantindo a mitigação de riscos fiscais.
  • Acompanhar mudanças na legislação tributária federal e apoiar a equipe na análise crítica e implementação dos novos requisitos legais.
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos da área tributária, apoiando iniciativas de compliance, governança fiscal e transformação digital.
  • Revisar a conciliação das contas contábeis de tributos federais, garantindo a integridade e correção das informações fiscais.
  • Orientar a equipe quanto ao controle e aplicação dos ajustes de Transfer Pricing, garantindo conformidade com a legislação vigente.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Job Description

Candidates must be fluent in English and submit their application in English to be considered.

Only those currently living in and authorized to work in Brazil are eligible. The application system will store candidate information. Once submitted, application details will be shared with Church Education System (CES) partners involved in the selection process. Applicants may receive a rejection email during or after review; however, unless a direct rejection is received from the hiring manager, applications will remain active and under consideration.

Responsibilities

  • The Computer Programming Course Instructor is an important part of the instructional team. With a strong focus on the academic success of every student, instructors use their subject matter expertise, deep understanding of the curriculum, and student population to:
  • Identify trends impeding academic success.
  • Conduct targeted outreach and provide instruction to target groups and individuals.
  • Build capable learners, confident in their ability to succeed academically and in life.
  • Instructors do not develop lessons or assessments, nor do they issue grades on student work (grading is handled by a centrally managed pool of qualified Graders).
  • Their focus is on the academic success of every student in their care.

Important: This is a part-time work-from-home position with the following flexible schedule:

  • 10-12 hours per week (may vary week-to-week)
  • At least 5 days worked each week
  • Required attendance at periodic team meetings (as established by the department)

Course Description

Teaching and mentoring students (using Python and C#) for:

  • CSE 110 - Introduction to Programming
  • CSE 111 - Programming with Functions
  • CSE 210 - Programming with Classes
  • CSE 212 - Programming with Data Structures

These courses provide students with foundational computer programming skills, enabling them to contribute to software development teams.

Position Summary

BYU Pathway and BYU Idaho online courses are structured to include both an instructor and graders. Instructors are responsible for teaching and overall course delivery, while graders support the learning process by reviewing and evaluating assignments and providing students with constructive feedback. We are seeking instructors who will apply their skills and subject matter expertise to mentor students and facilitate teaching/learning experiences.

Qualifications

NOTE : An applicant’s résumé and official transcripts will be used to determine eligibility to serve as an instructor for the Computer Programming courses. Please clearly highlight relevant education, professional work, and technologies on your résumé.

General Instructor Requirements

  • Deep understanding of and commitment to BYU Pathway Worldwide’s mission, defining characteristics, and student population.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (required).
  • Adaptability to new processes, procedures, and technologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills: professional, respectful, and unbiased in sensitive situations.
  • Proven reliability and ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, video conferencing, and discipline-specific software.
  • Experience with online teaching/learning, especially with at-risk learners (preferred).

Specific Course Requirements: Computer Programming

  • A master’s degree in computer science or a related field and two years of professional software development experience is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree and 3-5 years of work experience may be considered.
  • Experience with Python, C#, or Java is required.
  • Expert proficiency with basic programming concepts, such as variables, data types, collections, loops, functions, libraries, I/O, error handling, and testing.
  • Expert proficiency with basic object-oriented programming concepts, such as classes, methods, variables, and access modifiers.
  • Familiarity with data structures and algorithms.
  • Understanding object-oriented principles, such as abstraction, encapsulation, polymorphism, and inheritance.
  • Experience with version control software, such as GitHub.
  • Experience with code editors, such as Visual Studio Code.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing.

Additional Documentation Requirement

Candidates advancing to the next stage of the hiring process will be required to provide the following academic documents:

  • Official transcript (histórico escolar) of a completed bachelor’s or master’s degree. The transcript must be sent directly from the awarding institution, either in digital or physical format. Transcripts submitted by the candidate, regardless of format, will not be considered official for accreditation or academic credential verification purposes. This process may take time and may involve additional expenses, depending on the institution.
  • Copy of diploma (front and back) showing the date of degree completion or the date of the graduation/commencement ceremony (data da colação de grau).

Academic documents issued by Brazilian or international institutions are acceptable, provided they are officially recognized in Brazil and the country of origin (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional). Not applicable: in-progress transcripts and associate-level degrees. A completed bachelor’s degree is the minimum requirement for this position.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds who share the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building Ledn to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be passionate about innovation and creative problem solving, and adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. This role requires a highly motivated, dependable technologist who shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You’ll Do

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Support macOS in an enterprise setting; procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and policies, and contribute improvements to knowledge resources.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM with Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and improve IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets; work on projects over sprints with Jira (agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc., and to use open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures.
  • Security-minded with understanding of PGP; knowledge of networking fundamentals and OSI model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage and scope projects across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We look for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment; possess a builder’s mindset; be a collaborative partner who can influence across functions with empathy and clarity; demonstrate integrity and accountability; and have remote-work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a PTO package and equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a focus on removing barriers so you love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Equal Opportunity and Recruitment Notes

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. We are a remote-first, global team and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We may request a short video response or review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. No agencies or recruiters, please.

description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Will Do

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You$_39;ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.

Qualifications (continued)

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.
  • Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line interfaces; Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst to our Marketing B2B team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Marketing Data Analyst is an embedded analyst position that plays a key role in transforming marketing data into dashboards and reports that drive strategic decisions across marketing initiatives. This role's primary responsibility is to support Insights Managers by preparing clean, accurate, and repeatable data assets and reports. The analyst will transform business questions and challenges into queries and dashboards, ensuring that the data product ecosystem is robust and consistent for others to consume. This key player shapes marketing strategy through targeted data products, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating across teams to enable data-driven insights.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Data Preparation: Translate business or insight questions into queries, reports, and/or dashboards, and collaborate with Insights Managers on how we want to give visibility to this data (understanding the “why” and the business challenge)
  • Dashboard Creation: Build and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor performance metrics.
  • Data Governance: Ensure the consistent usage of concepts, metrics, and KPI definitions across our data products.
  • Quality Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability in our dashboards by proactively detecting possible data deviations and working with Analytics Engineers to resolve them. Develop new business quality tests for new data products.
  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Collaborate with the Global Analytics team to ensure a robust data product ecosystem and consistent reporting methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Relationship: Collaborate closely with Insights Managers and business stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure analytics deliverables align with their objectives.
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related fields.
  • Previous experience with Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence or Data Science.
  • Proficiency in BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Amplitude).
  • Advanced knowledge in SQL and/or Python for data analysis and exploration.
  • Preferred knowledge of marketing technology platforms such as Hubspot, SFMC, Braze, or Segment.
  • Understanding of marketing concepts and user journeys.
  • Strong storytelling and data presentations skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with Tableau, Metabase, Python or SQL and advanced english are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

Follow us on Instagram lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

Voluntary Self Identification

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
About Ledn

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role & Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’ll balance help desk tickets and prioritize them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You’ll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and align them to the team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You know how to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs and integrate one system to another.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; able to explain ideas clearly and help users calmly.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others; you take security seriously and know what PGP is.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. Familiar with OSI model troubleshooting steps. Ability to self-manage and scope projects across multiple teams.

Nice to Have & Culture

  • Some familiarity with AWS; used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies Ledn values.
  • Builder’s mindset, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package, with equity and remote work options up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company.
  • Remote-first environment with global team.
  • Purpose-driven career and inclusive, diverse culture. Equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests can be made confidentially.

Other Information

  • Ledn is a global, remote-first company with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
  • As part of the selection process, candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.
  • No agencies or recruiters; we do not accept unsolicited resumes or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Ledn. Get notified about new Information Technology Manager jobs in Rio Branco, Mato Grosso, Brazil .
