title: Finance & FP&A Analyst
description:
Overview

Finance & FP&A Analyst at LunaJoy Health. This role reports to the Compliance Lead within the Operations (Finance, Compliance, IT) department. LunaJoy Health is a leading provider of mental health services focused on supporting women through their mental wellness journey. We offer holistic therapy and medication management and operate in a collaborative, flexible, and remote environment.

Base pay range: $1,500.00/yr - $2,000.00/yr .

Job Title and Department

Job Title : Finance & FP&A Analyst
Department : Operations (Finance, Compliance, IT)
Reports to : Compliance Lead

Job Overview

We are seeking a Finance & FP&A Analyst to join our leadership team. This role is critical in overseeing LunaJoy’s financial operations, compliance functions, and information technology infrastructure. You will ensure financial integrity, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and data security while supporting the organization’s growth trajectory. You will contribute to our mission of supporting the mental health journey of one million women through purpose-driven innovation, financial stewardship, and regulatory excellence. You should operate with a startup mentality, build strong controls, and align your work with LunaJoy’s values of resilience, joy, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Finance
  • Prepare and maintain accurate financial statements (income statements, balance sheets, cash flow).
  • Ensure accurate bookkeeping and timely month-end closings using QuickBooks Online.
  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling to guide strategic decision-making.
  • Monitor and manage cash flow, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll disbursement.
  • Oversee revenue cycle management (RCM), accrual accounting, and vendor partnerships.
  • Develop and maintain investor reports, financial metrics (LTV, CAC by channel), and monthly dashboards.
  • Support venture fundraising, including projections, dilution modeling, and capitalization table management.
  • Manage 409A valuations and compliance with tax/audit requirements.
  • Drive automation and AI integration in finance workflows.
  • Compliance & Legal
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, SOC2, and healthcare regulatory requirements.
  • Lead vendor audits and manage compliance-related SOPs across the organization.
  • Oversee insurance policies (medical malpractice, liability, business coverage).
  • Manage patient- and customer-facing documentation (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy).
  • Partner with legal counsel to maintain and issue contract templates, NDAs, and board/investor documentation.
  • Information Technology
  • Partner with IT leadership to ensure secure, scalable technology infrastructure.
  • Support AI-driven and automation-focused process improvements across finance and compliance.
  • Strategic & Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Collaborate with billing, credentialing, marketing, and clinical leadership to streamline operations.
  • Lead M&A financial diligence and integration processes.
  • Build SOPs and internal controls to safeguard assets and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Drive process improvement initiatives that enhance scalability, automation, and efficiency.

Qualifications And Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or related field (MBA or CPA preferred).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience managing finance and/or compliance operations in a startup or healthcare organization.
  • Strong understanding of HIPAA, SOC2, and healthcare regulatory frameworks.
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online, Google Suite, Microsoft Suite, and spreadsheet modeling.
  • Experience with revenue cycle management, U.S. healthcare payer structures, and startup fundraising (SAFE notes, valuation, equity modeling, Series A/B/C terms).
  • Ability to analyze data, develop financial models, and translate insights into strategy.
  • Demonstrated leadership and people management skills in high-growth, fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills.
  • Alignment with LunaJoy’s values: Wolf Mentality, 1% Better, Resilient & Resourceful, Customers Determine Our Success, Speed is a Habit, Give & Get Joy.
  • Nice To Haves
  • CPA, CFA, or equivalent financial certification.
  • Prior experience leading finance in a venture-backed healthcare company.
  • Exposure to AI and automation in finance or compliance functions.
  • Experience in M&A integration and investor relations.

Why LunaJoy?

  • Mission-Driven Purpose: Directly contribute to improving access to mental health care for women.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Fully remote role with supportive, collaborative team culture.
  • Growth & Impact: Build scalable finance and compliance systems that power national expansion.
  • Compensation: Salary range of USD$1,500 - $2,000 per month, with growth opportunities.
  • Community: Join a team of diverse, passionate professionals committed to innovation and impact.

Interview Process

  • HR Screen – Initial alignment on skills, values, and culture.
  • Hiring Manager Interview – Deep dive into financial, compliance, and operational expertise.
  • Offer Stage – Formal offer with compensation and role details.
  • Onboarding & Training – Guided integration into LunaJoy systems, tools, and workflows.

We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where all team members feel valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives strengthens our ability to support women’s mental health. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join us in creating a positive impact in our communities.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Ledn offers a suite of lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. The core values guide us: act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating and changing financial services for the better.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This role reports to the Director of IT. You will be customer-facing and the first line of support, owning the support experience for employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We are Mac-focused, you will troubleshoot, use the terminal, and manage enterprise macOS deployments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and own onboarding and offboarding experiences. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and improve knowledge bases. You will manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools. You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools and automate busywork. You will manage incidents and balance tickets with project work in agile environments.

What You Bring to Ledn:

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear writing for tickets, emails and Slack.
  • Proficiency in documenting solutions and automating routine tasks.
  • Experience with enterprise macOS management and SaaS tools listed above.
  • Networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); OSI model understanding.
  • Self-management and ability to scope projects and work across multiple teams; agile experience with Jira.

Nice to Haves:

  • Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line tooling; Jamf and Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment, values-driven, empathetic, and collaborative.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive rewards package and ownership in the company via equity; remote work worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Competitive PTO and a meaningful career with purpose.
  • Inclusive, diverse and equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests available during recruitment.

Equal Opportunity

Ledn is an equal opportunity employment organization and prides itself on inclusivity and the success that comes from diversity. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited resumes; applicants are asked to refrain from submitting agency resumes.

Equity Grade - 5

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

4 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Bring to Ledn

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints). You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn (continued): 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You have provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.) You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide: As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Our Environment & Application process

Ledn Working Environment Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Job details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Retail

title: Product Owner
description:
Analista de Atração e Seleção Sênior| Tech Recruiter

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.

Sobre a área:

A área de Produto Digital é responsável por evoluir os produtos da empresa, garantindo alta performance, experiência do usuário diferenciada e integração com os demais. Temos como objetivo aumentar a adoção, engajamento e satisfação dos usuários, assegurando entregas alinhadas às estratégias de negócio e à qualidade técnica esperada.

Principais atividades:

Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos.

Análise de mercado e Bench com identificação de tendências de aplicativos e canais digitais.

Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e critérios de aceitação claros.

Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras. Tomar decisões de Go/No Go da entrega na Review;

Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões

Conduzir refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas seguindo metodologias ágeis.

Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades junto aos usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.

Gerenciar os stakeholders e garantir a comunicação (estratégias e ações).

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Necessário graduação completa.

Necessário domínio do Pacote Office.

Necessário conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio a gestão de projetos e produtos.

Necessário conhecimento em Scrum e frameworks ágeis.

Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou posição similar, com atuação em produtos digitais.

Vivência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis (iOS e Android).

Habilidade em análise de métricas de produto (Firebase, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).

Boa comunicação e capacidade de articular diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar na gestão de aplicativos digitais , com foco especial no aplicativo de resultados de exames , garantindo priorização assertiva das demandas e interlocução com diferentes áreas e regionais. Procuramos alguém com experiência avançada em aplicativos digitais , que seja articulada, saiba se posicionar com clareza e tenha facilidade em conduzir conversas estratégicas com diferentes públicos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad , garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da área. Também terá atuação próxima do time digital localizado em São Paulo , influenciando e direcionando prioridades de forma indireta e estruturada.

Buscamos alguém com conhecimento aprofundado sobre as lojas da Apple e Google , incluindo políticas, publicações e boas práticas de atualização de aplicativos.

Principais atividades:

  • Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e com critérios de aceitação claros.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras.
  • Realizar análise de mercado e benchmarking para identificar tendências em aplicativos e canais digitais.
  • Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas).
  • Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades com usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders e garantir a comunicação clara sobre estratégias e ações.

Se você tem perfil estratégico, domínio de aplicativos digitais e gosta de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e orientada a resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Horário de Trabalho: de segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48

Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!

Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.

Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.

Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.

Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.

Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

  • Garantir que as entregas estejam alinhadas à estratégia de CRM e transformação digital da organização;
  • Construir o roadmap ou conjunto de objetivos com a perspectiva de evolução do produto, alinhado com a estratégia da empresa;
  • Realizar a gestão dos processos de incidentes, eventos e problemas;
  • Conduzir checkpoints, status report e alinhamentos de negócio.

  • Domínio funcional de Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (certificação é diferencial);
  • Conhecimento prático em automação de processos (Flows, Validation Rules, Approval Process);
  • Noções de integrações e APIs REST/SOAP no ecossistema Salesforce;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Scrum/Kanban;
  • Habilidade para elaborar user stories e critérios de aceitação claros e testáveis;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão ágil (Jira, Confluence, ADO, etc.).

Diferenciais

  • Certificações:
  • Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201)

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable, creative in problem solving, and able to work in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We predominantly work on macOS, and you will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding departing employees. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools. You will detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix incidents as needed. You will work on projects over sprints, and document your work in Jira. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn :

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of API integrations between systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear, friendly, and concise writing.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, macOS enterprise configuration, and technical onboarding/offboarding processes.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI model; ability to troubleshoot methodically.
  • Self-management with clear scoping of projects and priorities across multiple teams.

Nice to Have : Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit : You thrive in a startup/tech environment, value integrity and accountability, and can influence across functions with empathy and clarity. Experience working in a remote environment is a plus.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, competitive PTO, ownership in the company through equity, and remote work opportunities worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). We aim to remove barriers so you can love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing the Ledn team throughout all stages of the recruitment process; requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

  • Employment type : Full-time
  • Job function : Information Technology
  • Industries : Retail

Onco360 is searching for an Inside Sales Representative - Oncology. This is a fully remote position. Onco360 Pharmacy is a unique oncology pharmacy model created to serve the needs of community, oncology and hematology physicians, patients, payers, and manufacturers.

A career with us is more than just a job. It\'s an opportunity to connect and care for our patients, providers, communities and each other. We attract extraordinary people who have a strong desire to live our mission - to better the lives of those battling cancer and rare diseases. Compassion is more important than numbers. We value teamwork, respect, integrity, and passion.

We succeed when you do, and our company and management team work hard to foster an environment that provides you with opportunities for both professional and personal growth.

Base Salary range $55k-$70k annually; plus Commission

Summary:

Using a balance of account management and direct telephone outreach, the primary responsibility of the Inside Sales position will be to develop and manage a designated territory with the goal of providing education and care coordination to prescribers for all Onco360 products and services. This position acts as a single point of contact by assisting the prescriber in evaluating referrals and performing care coordination to ensure service level requirements are met. In most cases this responsibility is carried out in coordination with a mirrored outside sales representative. The targeted customers are physicians, NPs, PAs, nursing staff, office managers, administrative and pharmacy staff within both hospital and community oncology settings. This position will be home based with minimal travel as required to execute the following:

Regional Director Major Responsibilities

  • Seeks out opportunities for prescriber experience process improvement and collaborates with Pharmacy OPS and outside sales to achieve prescriber experience improvement and sales goals
  • Achieves designated call expectations for assigned prescribers with a focus on top targets, key influencers, and pipeline leads
  • Responsible for identifying, ranking, prospecting, and developing key oncology practice and hospital-based business relationships within targeted regional territory
  • Assists with sales escalations and communicates routinely with field sales representative partner about details impacting prescriber or patient experience
  • Supports education and delivery of key messages and product presentations within initiatives (i.e. Selling our Success communication, drug launches, etc.) designed to ensure territory meets performance requirements
  • Responsible for forwarding calls pertaining to clinical information and questions (i.e., dosing directions, adverse events, counseling, etc.) to Staff Pharmacists
  • Documents and meticulously makes notations in each patient\'s profile and/or CRM regarding every update and aspect of a customer\'s/physician\'s care or needs
  • Uses discretion and independent judgment in handling customer complaints received, while documenting and forwarding to appropriate administrative staff.
  • Obtains and manages prescriber communication preferences
  • Nurtures and manages prescriber relationship to improve loyalty, and retention.
  • Utilizes SPOC Tool to ensure all SPOC account prescriptions are processed quickly and efficiently throughout the workflow process.
  • Assists operations staff and prescriber offices with prior authorizations by following up on outstanding issues and assisting with coordination and communication.
  • Ensure that prescription renewal requests are communicated in a timely manner to ensure continuity of care when applicable.
  • Works collaboratively with sales to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals

Regional Director Qualifications

  • 2 years’ retail or specialty pharmacy technician experience preferred - Must be familiar with general pharmacy terminology, billing quantity, SIG codes, roman numerals, brand, and generic names of medications, and IV dosage calculations/day supply.
  • 2 years inside or outside sales experience for pharmacy or other health services-related industry preferred
  • Oncology sales experience desired but not required
  • Exceptional probing and consultative communication skills
  • Familiar with oncology providers, drugs, clinic, and hospital communities
  • Understanding of oncology drug reimbursement, Managed Care Medical Specialty and PBM drug benefits
  • Self-motivated and results driven
  • Highly effective in working objectively with a diverse group of people and must demonstrate communication, organizational, administrative and office skills

Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Ledn’s team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds, with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s products and services can play a critical role in doing so. Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • You will be customer-facing, the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.
  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’ll juggle help desk tickets and prioritize them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in Jira (agile methods and sprints).
  • You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and align them to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS and experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: We look for a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer remote work flexibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and opportunities for growth. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Working Environment

  • Ledn is global and remote-first. Our people span North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

  • Contribute to the development and management of knowledge-sharing methodologies, diagnostic tools, and creative processes, to improve the client experience

Experience

title: Tech manager
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Saiba mais sobre a Lemon

Sobre o Time De Tech

O time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares e somos responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis e eficientes que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. No nosso backend usamos principalmente aws com node.js e microsserviços orientados a eventos assíncronos. Nosso principal banco de dados é o DynamoDB. Toda a nossa infra é serverless e criada como código. Usamos jest e github actions para nossos testes e deploys. Saiba mais sobre a nossa stack aqui.

Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe que está na vanguarda da tecnologia e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Ter a chance real de participar da formação de uma empresa unicórnio;
  • Fazer a diferença em uma empresa que tem um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro atualmente;
  • Conseguir aplicar soluções tecnológicas que impactam positivamente o meio onde vivemos;
  • Liderar a direção técnica do time, garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de qualidade;
  • Representar o time de engenharia em discussões estratégicas e processos de tomada de decisão;
  • Supervisionar a arquitetura e o design de sistemas complexos, assegurando escalabilidade, estabilidade e custos;
  • Ser responsável pela formação e times de alta performance na área de tecnologia.
O Perfil Que Buscamos

  • Pró-atividade para resolver desafios complexos e muita vontade de fazer acontecer, passividade não faz parte deste perfil;
  • Capacidade de inspirar e motivar o time, direcionando-o para a excelência e inovação;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos para partes interessadas não técnicas;
  • Mentalidade de ownership: responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Flexibilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e de mudanças frequentes (somos uma startup);
  • Conexão com o impacto de negócio e entendimento do porquê por trás das soluções;
  • Comunicação clara, respeitosa e madura, com abertura para dar e receber feedback;
  • Empatia para trabalhar bem com pessoas de diferentes áreas e perfis;
  • Compromisso com o próprio desenvolvimento contínuo.
Experiência Prévia / Habilidades Exigidas

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos atuando como líder ténico;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de Experiência em gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de equipes de tecnologia;
  • Experiência comprovada na entrega de projetos de larga escala e alto impacto;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo DDD, microservices e arquiteturas baseadas em cloud;
  • Habilidade para equilibrar excelência técnica com pragmatismo e entrega de valor ao negócio.
Será Um Diferencial Se Você Já Tiver Conhecimentos Em (Não Esperamos Que Você Já Conheça Tudo Isso, Procuramos Pessoas Curiosas e Que Estejam Dispostas a Aprender)

  • Experiência no setor de energia e/ou em startups de rápido crescimento;
  • Conhecimento em Node.js e React;
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias de cloud computing, especialmente AWS;
  • Compreensão de desafios regulatórios e de compliance em setores regulados.
O Que a Gente Oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (pode ser usado nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (além dos feriados nacionais, você tem alguns dias no ano à sua escolha para curtir uma folguinha ou emendar o descanso antes ou depois de um feriado).
Leia Aqui Por Favor

Pesquisas mostram que pessoas que se identificam como homens candidatam-se a um trabalho quando consideram que cumprem 60% dos requisitos, já pessoas que se identificam como mulheres e outros grupos minorizados tendem a aplicar apenas quando preenchem todos os requisitos possíveis. Então, se você acredita que possui habilidades para mudar o futuro da energia no país com a gente, mas não necessariamente preenche tudo listado acima, por favor prossiga na vaga. Adoraríamos bater um papo e descobrir se você é quem estamos procurando.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético e, por isso, estamos engajados para nos tornarmos uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e caso se sinta confortável, gostaríamos de saber na sua candidatura se auto identifica/declara pertencente a algum ou alguns grupos de diversidade.

Encorajamos que se candidatem pessoas com as mais diferentes histórias e vivências, pois isso nos auxilia a criar um ambiente mais inclusivo.

title: Technical Product Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
Overview

This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Technical Product Support Engineer (Remote) in Latin America .

  • Familiarity with API technologies and tools like Postman for troubleshooting
  • Excellent communication, listening, and interpersonal skills to interact confidently with clients
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize workload, and work independently in a remote environment
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to assisting customers and resolving issues

Benefits

  • Remote work across Latin America with flexible schedule
  • Opportunity to work with innovative communication and connectivity technologies
  • Exposure to advanced troubleshooting tools and industry protocols
  • Collaboration with a skilled, distributed team of engineers and technical experts
  • Professional growth and skill development in technical support and product engineering

Jobgether is a Talent Matching Platform that partners with companies worldwide to efficiently connect top talent with the right opportunities through AI-driven job matching.

When you apply, your profile goes through our AI-powered screening process designed to identify top talent efficiently and fairly.

About the Role

Senior Product Designer to lead the design of a new, high-impact product within our growing mobility platform. This role blends UX strategy, visual design, and product thinking—from user research and usability testing to building intuitive, production-ready interfaces in Figma. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and designers, helping shape a cohesive design system and elevating the overall product experience. This position offers the opportunity to work in a startup-paced environment, where your ideas will directly influence product direction and user satisfaction.

Title: Senior Product Designer

  • Design from Discovery to Delivery: Conduct user research and usability testing, translate insights into wireframes and prototypes, and ship elegant, production-ready designs.
  • Own the Visual System: Create scalable, consistent design components in Figma, contributing to and expanding our design system.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with product managers, engineers, and other designers to define problems, explore solutions, and iterate quickly.
  • Champion the User: Bring a user-first mindset to ensure designs are functional, accessible, and visually cohesive across platforms.
  • Contribute to Culture: Collaborate with the broader design team (4+ designers plus UX lead) to evolve design standards, processes, and best practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on product design experience spanning UI and UX for web or mobile applications.

  • Product Mindset: Proven success designing within software development environments, collaborating closely with engineers and PMs.
  • User-Centric Skills: Strong background in usability testing, user interviews, and turning insights into thoughtful design solutions.
  • Portfolio Quality: Work that demonstrates polished, interaction-focused design for complex digital products.
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (written and spoken).
  • Work Ethic: Startup mentality — proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Nice-to-Have: Experience designing for B2B, logistics, or other complex system-driven products.

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere we hire, with built-in flexibility. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is diverse and values integrity, ownership, progress, and empathy. We are a remote-first organization with a global presence.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is committed to helping end users. You will design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks, and collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The role reports to the Director of IT.

What You Will Do

  • Provide customer-facing IT support; own support channels via Slack, Jira, etc.; manage Mac endpoints and enterprise macOS deployments.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences; design, test, build, and document programs, policies, tools, and improvements to knowledge base.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM/Jamf).
  • Contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.); write solutions, help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents; prioritize help desk tickets; work on projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Experience creating automations with Bash, Zsh, Python; using open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows; strong API integration skills; remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and calmly; strong ticketing and documentation skills.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting and macOS enterprise environments; strong networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing); understanding OSI model layers and methodical troubleshooting; self-management and multi-team coordination.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; ability to handle ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience using GAM and CLI tools; Jamf and Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment with values alignment.

Benefits and What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity; remote work eligibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose; removal of barriers to help you love what you do; inclusive, diverse environment; equal opportunity employer.

Ledn is globally distributed with a remote-first environment. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.   • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.

Join to apply for the Finance Transformation Automation Associate role at dLocal

Overview

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets. By joining us you will be part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives.

What’s the opportunity?

  • We are seeking a Finance Transformation Automation Associate to drive the automation of financial and operational reconciliations. This role involves integrating data sources from banks and processors (APIs, SFTP, email), standardizing controls, and systematizing variance analysis to accelerate closes and reduce rework. The role blends financial–operational knowledge with skills in data ingestion services, and secure connectivity to move and validate data at scale. Success requires strong proficiency in Excel, familiarity with SQL and Python, and a strong focus on continuous improvement in an agile, fast-paced environment.

What will I be doing?

  • Integrate and maintain data sources from banks/processors via APIs, SFTP, and email workflows, ensuring data quality, completeness, and traceability
  • Execute and improve reconciliation controls for the different types of transactions supported by dashboards, matching rules, and audit evidence
  • Prepare and cleanse inputs (reconcilable groups, rules, sweeps), coordinating adjustments and new implementations with responsible teams
  • Analyze variances and differences across banks, processors, and internal records; conduct root-cause analysis and propose remedial actions and automation solutions
  • Develop analytical models (pivot tables, lookups; Power Query/Power Pivot, or equivalent) for KPIs, variance monitoring, and control tracking
  • Manage tickets and workflows in Jira for new reconciliations, rule/sweep changes, file uploads/removals, following strong documentation practices
  • Collaborate with Business Assurance, Operations, Treasury, Accounting, Product, and Data to resolve incidents, capture requirements, and coordinate UAT for new integrations
  • Standardize SOPs, strengthen controls, and scale end-to-end automations to reduce manual work, and rework during closes
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously in an agile context: gathering requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, performing UAT, and managing change

What skills do I need?

  • 2-4+ years in Finance Transformation, Treasury, Finance Operations, Engineering, or Process Automation, ideally within payments, fintech, or banking
  • Advanced Excel proficiency
  • Experience with SQL, Python and automation, with a track record of implementing tech-driven solutions
  • Experience with data ingestion and secure connectivity: APIs, SFTP, CSV/JSON; familiarity with VPN and SSH keys
  • Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI) is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, ability to context-switch across multiple projects
  • Growth mindset with high adaptability, comfort with change, and an agile way of working
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills
  • Fluent in spoken and written English

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe*
  • Flexibility: flexible schedules and performance-driven culture
  • Fintech industry: dynamic environment with opportunities to build and boost creativity
  • Referral bonus program: employees can refer candidates and earn rewards
  • Learning & development: Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: monthly budget to engage with your team
  • dLocal Houses: option to rent a house and work remotely with your team
  • Location note: for Montevideo-based roles, attendance requirement at the office is 55% (not applicable to IT and Fraud roles)

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you posted by email at every step of the process.

Additional information

For more about dLocal, check our webpage, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn\'s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit). You\'ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will

Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. Job description

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!

Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Main responsibilities

Coordenador(a)/Lead de Design responsável por assegurar a qualidade técnica do produto digital e demonstrar, com evidências, o impacto do design nos resultados do negócio. Atuará de forma integrada aos times de Produto e Tecnologia, conduzindo a experiência de ponta a ponta — da concepção à entrega — com coerência entre jornadas, interfaces, estados e conteúdo, e registrando comparativos “antes/depois” que sustentem decisões executivas.

  • Liderar e orientar um time de designers, planejando capacidade, prioridades e removendo impedimentos.
  • Garantir a qualidade do design em todo o ciclo (discovery à entrega), incluindo arquitetura de informação, fluxos com corte vertical, microinterações, tratamento de erros e estados vazios.
  • Assegurar a aplicação consistente do Design System (tokens, variantes, guidelines), governança de contribuições e prevenção de regressões.
  • Zelar pela acessibilidade, incluindo requisitos regulatórios quando aplicável.
  • Direcionar atividades de pesquisa (sem execução direta), conectando achados a decisões de design e evolução do backlog.
  • Conduzir críticas de design, definir critérios de qualidade (“quality gates”) e promover consistência entre iniciativas e squads.
  • Articular decisões com Produto e Engenharia, apresentando raciocínio, protótipos e evidências que sustentem escolhas técnicas e de experiência.
  • Documentar e apresentar resultados com comparativos “antes/depois” (ex.: redução de atritos, erros e etapas; aumento de completude de tarefas; diminuição de chamados de suporte).

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança ou coordenação de times de design de produto/serviço.
  • Excelência técnica em UX/UI: arquitetura de informação, design de interação, design visual, microinterações e padrões de conteúdo.
  • Domínio de Figma (auto-layout, variants, design tokens) e boas práticas de handoff para Engenharia.
  • Vivência com Design System em produto vivo (versionamento, contribuição e gestão de estados críticos).

Overview

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success.
